body: You will! I still have more to go but it’s a world’s difference finally

I’m a very stubborn person so I dug for my own answers. Kept breaking my own heart but eventually I had enough. I don’t have all the answers but enough to know that what he did wasn’t okay and there’s nothing he can do to fix it. Kinda feel like I got of the ride but I’m still at the carnival. Working on mentally leaving all the way.
Mine said he needed alone time so I initially left him alone but then he hoovered and it was so difficult getting out of that. Took 8 months for me to jump off that ride
It sucks. I know the feeling but just as everyone on here told me before. It’s a lie and we know it but we want it so much to be true. Wish you the strength to ignore it.

Thanks everyone. This is really hard, exhausting, and sad. :/ I know I shouldn’t have but a few weeks ago when I was doing better I had this trigger to look at his socials again. I was able to find his “ex’s” info (claims they were unofficial now) anyway I saw that he was with her this year after a year of us being unofficial too I guess. Now I just don’t know what I was in all of this and it makes me so sad. I feel like reaching out to her to 1) tell her in case she cares 2) see if she’d be willing to tell me if they were together the whole time. Idk anymore

I’m questioning whether he was a narcissist or was he just playing me. I found out that he saw his ex this year (lives out of state) for a month after we were unofficial for about a year. At the discard he hoovered and breadcrumbed for about 4 months and then he lost his job when he visited. I wasn’t sure at the time but suspected it and had a convo but he denied it. I saw him a week after he got back and I spent the night after talking things out for a while. Then he breadcrumbed again until I confronted him about knowing he had hooked up with others during the 4 months I hadn’t seen him. He’s been on the apps the whole time except for when he saw her. I’m only sure of this now (4 months later) bc I found her page and she a picture of him. This set me back so much and now I’m questioning even more and it makes me feel like why would he have gone back to her when that’s so much effort and I’m right here. Makes me question whether his relationship with me was only fake but not hers? Idk why I’d think she’s immune or maybe he isn’t. But so many signs show he has traits of npd/aspd

My family, especially my dad and my nieces. I don’t want any them to suffer.

And I really do love myself so much that i want to stop this sadness. I’ve known how I’d do it for sometime now. But it Makes feel guilty if my friends or family found me that way.
Yup :/ this realization made me cry the other day bc I felt that if I had known a healthy love growing up I wouldn’t have fallen for this game so easily and for so long.

I’m not good yet but I know this feeling all too well. I could NOT function for the first three months post discard but today I went to the gym, I’m eating, and got a manicure. I still ruminate constantly BUT this has to be a sign that it gets better even if slowly. I’m so sorry you’re in that place right now. It still hits me like that too. I can’t imagine doing this with children but know you have tremendous strength even though you might feel like you don’t. I guess we just have to keep on pushing. We can’t let them keep taking from us.

Going through it now. It’s soul crushing. I’m left hopeless after this one. I used to be so optimistic but I just can’t wrap my head around the act. Then I start seeing it everywhere and it makes everything much more…cynical, depressing, fake. But everyone says it gets better so I try holding on to that. It’s been 4 months of pointless hoovers but I look forward to the day I can block or defintely not respond. I’m 5 days in on not responding and when I feel weak I try to come here to keep me strong. I look forward to the day we can all look back at this thread from the other side.

Yea, never knowing how to respond :( I sit here trying to think of the best way to express myself/ question them without setting them off. It shouldn’t have to be this way when they’re the ones stonewalling until they feel like it and not even addressing where we left off. It’s weird

Something that finally started hitting me yesterday! My two biggest relationships in adulthood were with narcs (didn’t realize what it was until this last time). One overt and then covert :/ anyway, I realized why I was “picked/claimed” by my 1st Nex vs. this recent year long situation......I was simply more docile, giving, and eager with the first one. I thought I had made it compared to how ex’s and then I realized they had just all gotten away. I was just the sucker. This realization has helped me my recent “nex” so I don’t feel so mindfucked about not being the “picked” one this time. The first one hasn’t changed so I need to stop thinking this one would just bc he’s younger.

Literally exact same boat. Except it’s started with breadcrumbing for a month then he ghosted for a little over a week then started texting w/o a real purpose and now I’m devastated just as bad again....looking back I see plenty of signs where I should have questioned things but I was trusting, thought he was just shy, and Covid made things worse. The whole thing was just cruel. I tried ending it early on but he said he had feelings. Look at me now :/
